current_state.zh: Andrej Karpathy used Claude Code (Opus 5.5 for pipeline and deployment, Sonnet for classifying ~43M Hacker News comments) to build and launch HackerTube, a login-free YouTube recommendation site indexing 6,454 videos across 150 topics with the curated dataset released for download.
